name: Quantoz USDQ
oneLiner: USDQ is Quantoz Payments' MiCA-authorized dollar e-money token, backed by dollar cash deposits and U.S. Treasuries.
collateral: U.S. dollar cash deposits and U.S. Treasuries safeguarded through Stichting Quantoz, separate from Quantoz Payments' operating funds. Quantoz describes the foundation as bankruptcy-remote and uses multiple undisclosed Tier 1 European banking partners; the USDQ reserve snapshot is self-reported.
pegMechanism: Quantoz's current redemption webpage offers direct face-value redemption to a verified bank account in the holder's own name after identity, token-ownership and source-of-funds checks, without requiring a pre-existing token account, for holders with a verified address and bank account in the EEA, UK or Switzerland. It allows up to one week for on-chain compliance checks after confirmed receipt, followed by the Terms of Service payout schedule. The linked USDQ whitepaper v1.4 dated 30 April 2026 instead describes direct redemption for registered EEA-resident USDQ Account Holders and directs other holders to partners; this eligibility discrepancy remains unresolved. Secondary-market sales are on venue terms.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Quantoz's USDQ disclosure describes direct 1:1 redemption for onboarded customers and a segregated reserve of cash deposits and government bonds. The disclosed 30% cash and 70% government-bond allocation supports the fiat-cash classification. The reviewed materials do not provide an independent current assurance opinion, full bank/custodian identity, or complete legal claim and insolvency treatment, so no stronger mechanism-component conclusion is made.
